name: Bloodmage: Dark Hunt boosts damage against bleeding targets and expertise (#2824)
contract: Dark Hunt 705733: "Increases your Shadow damage dealt by $s1% against bleeding targets. / Increases your expertise by $s2." Effect 0 is aura 303 SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_DONE_VERSUS_AURASTATE, amount 10, MiscValue 18 = AURA_STATE_BLEEDING, read natively in Unit::SpellDamageBonusDone (Unit.cpp:8829) and Unit::MeleeDamageBonus (Unit.cpp:10736). Effect 1 is aura 240 SPELL_AURA_MOD_EXPERTISE, amount 10, handled by AuraEffect::HandleAuraModExpertise (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:305) and consumed in Player::UpdateExpertise (StatSystem.cpp:1029). Crimson Tide 504282 carries Mechanic 15 = MECHANIC_BLEED, so SpellInfo::GetAuraState returns AURA_STATE_BLEEDING for its victim (SpellInfo.cpp:2192). The damage probe is Bloodmoon Blast 500125, SchoolMask 32 = Shadow. No source or SQL change is involved; this is a regression scenario for behaviour that is already native.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Shadow damage against the bleeding target is 10% higher
